assistant.title: Bridgetek EVE Assistant
assistant.headline: Bring your next EVE idea into focus.
assistant.description: Get engineering guidance for your EVE project through the Bridgetek EVE Assistant plugin in ChatGPT or Codex. Explore graphics and touch, work from official examples, and get help building and debugging your GUI.
assistant.families: FT80x · FT81x · BT815 / BT816 · BT817 / BT818 · BT820 / BT82x

features.title: Build your GUI
features.text: Start with an official EveApps sample. Get guidance on screens, controls, assets, emulator prototyping and MCU integration.

features.title: Understand your EVE
features.text: Explore display lists, coprocessor commands, memory, fonts and touch with guidance tailored to your EVE generation.

features.title: Debug with direction
features.text: Review code and SPI transactions to investigate blank displays, rendering problems, coprocessor faults and touch tags.

prompts: Help me build a touchscreen GUI for BT817 from an official EveApps sample.
Review my BT820 code for memory alignment and command FIFO handling.
My display is blank. Help me check initialization, SPI transactions and the display list.
assistant.install: Open the plugin listing to get started. Sign in to ChatGPT; usage limits depend on your plan.
assistant.note: For more useful guidance, include your EVE chip, display resolution, host MCU and relevant code. Verify implementation-critical details against official Bridgetek documentation.

features.title: 构建 GUI
features.text: 从官方 EveApps 示例开始，获取界面、控件、素材、仿真原型及 MCU 集成方面的指导。

features.title: 深入了解 EVE
features.text: 根据您的 EVE 芯片系列，探索显示列表、协处理器命令、存储器、字体与触摸功能。

features.title: 有方向地调试
features.text: 检查代码与 SPI 传输，排查黑屏、渲染异常、协处理器故障及触摸标签问题。

prompts: 请以官方 EveApps 示例为基础，帮我为 BT817 构建触摸屏 GUI。
请检查我的 BT820 代码中的存储器对齐与命令 FIFO 处理。
我的显示屏黑屏了，请帮我检查初始化、SPI 传输和显示列表。

cta.label: 获取 EVE Assistant 插件

assistant.install: 打开插件详情页即可开始。使用前需登录 ChatGPT，用量限制取决于您的套餐。
assistant.note: 请提供 EVE 芯片型号、显示分辨率、主控 MCU 和相关代码，以获得更有用的指导。关键实现细节请以 Bridgetek 官方文档为准。
